basicDetails.schemeName: Nirmaan Shramik  ke Bachchon Hetu  Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana

children.text: Benefits will only be provided to children of construction workers who are registered in any district within the state
The benefit of the scheme will be given only to those children whose excellence is recognized by the Sports Department.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Benefits will only be provided to children of construction workers who are registered in any district within the state
1. The benefit of the scheme will be given only to those children whose excellence is recognized by the Sports Department.

children.text: Incentive amount will be provided to the children who perform excellently at the district / division / state / national level in all recognized sports as follows -

schemeContent.benefits_md:
Incentive amount will be provided to the children who perform excellently at the district / division / state / national level in all recognized sports as follows -

1. Amount at district level: ₹ 1,000/-
1. Amount at divisional level: ₹ 2,000/-
1. Amount at state level: ₹ 5,000/-
1. Amount at National level : ₹ 50,000/-
schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Nirmaan Shramik  Ke Bachchon Hetu Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana" for Construction worker on 23 May 2017.

children.text: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Nirmaan Shramik  Ke Bachchon Hetu  Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana" for Construction Workers on 23 May 2017. The main objective of the scheme to provide financial to encourage the studdents for sports.
